feature: Pilot Control Ledger v3 schema and fault acceptance

cases.initial_state: Empty SQLite file; no user objects or metadata.
cases.action: Initialize v3 on two independent concurrent openers.
cases.oracle: Exactly one complete v3 schema is created; the other validates it; one metadata singleton; no partial objects; both connections verify foreign_keys and recursive_triggers.

cases.initial_state: Exact manifest v3 schema with valid metadata and rows.
cases.action: Open through every pooled-connection path.
cases.oracle: Every connection validates normalized DDL/inventory/version and pragmas; no writes or row changes.

cases.initial_state: Fixture database is v2 and has sentinel schema/data/metadata.
cases.action: Attempt v3 open with v2 schema.
cases.oracle: Reject closed; before/after schema SQL, user_version, metadata, sentinel rows byte-identical; no journal-mode mutation before rejection except documented WAL side effect.

cases.initial_state: Fixture database is partial and has sentinel schema/data/metadata.
cases.action: Attempt v3 open with partial schema.
cases.oracle: Reject closed; before/after schema SQL, user_version, metadata, sentinel rows byte-identical; no journal-mode mutation before rejection except documented WAL side effect.

cases.initial_state: Fixture database is tampered table/index/trigger and has sentinel schema/data/metadata.
cases.action: Attempt v3 open with tampered table/index/trigger schema.
cases.oracle: Reject closed; before/after schema SQL, user_version, metadata, sentinel rows byte-identical; no journal-mode mutation before rejection except documented WAL side effect.

cases.initial_state: Fixture database is wrong user_version and has sentinel schema/data/metadata.
cases.action: Attempt v3 open with wrong user_version schema.
cases.oracle: Reject closed; before/after schema SQL, user_version, metadata, sentinel rows byte-identical; no journal-mode mutation before rejection except documented WAL side effect.

cases.initial_state: Fixture database is extra view/virtual/temp object and has sentinel schema/data/metadata.
cases.action: Attempt v3 open with extra view/virtual/temp object schema.
cases.oracle: Reject closed; before/after schema SQL, user_version, metadata, sentinel rows byte-identical; no journal-mode mutation before rejection except documented WAL side effect.

cases.initial_state: Pool has at least 8 independently opened physical SQLite connections.
cases.action: Force each connection through init and query its pragmas.
cases.oracle: Each connection reads foreign_keys=1 and recursive_triggers=1 before any application SQL; failed connection is closed and never returned to pool.

cases.initial_state: Immutable identity row exists for each permanent table; collision keys prepared.
cases.action: Attempt INSERT OR REPLACE and conflicting UPSERT on every immutable identity and unique key.
cases.oracle: Every operation rejects; row bytes and all dependent rows unchanged; no delete/insert trigger bypass.

cases.initial_state: Seed immutable receipts, handoffs, generation rows, evidence, cleanup dispositions.
cases.action: Attempt UPDATE and DELETE per immutable table.
cases.oracle: Abort; exact table dumps and counts unchanged; safe event logs identify table/object only.

cases.initial_state: Frozen public-key and signed envelope vectors from docs/52; initialized auth state and fixture set.
cases.action: Run frozen valid vectors and reject tampered signature, request ID changed under old signature, noncanonical CBOR, trailing bytes, unsupported version/kind, duplicate fixture ID, exact replay, same ID changed payload with valid signature, new ID at reused revision, and multi-grant account snapshot.
cases.oracle: Invalid signature/envelope rejects before DB access; exact replay returns identical receipt with no writes; ID conflict/stale revision reject unchanged; valid account snapshot plus grant/tombstone rows and one receipt commit atomically or all roll back. Verify signature/digest against frozen vectors.

cases.initial_state: Empty valid schema; construct legal parent/child branches and wrong tuples.
cases.action: Exercise every FK, composite FK, restrict edge and required insertion order.
cases.oracle: Legal insertion order succeeds; each missing/mismatched/cross-tenant parent and delete/update rejects; transaction rows unchanged.

cases.initial_state: No control generation rows.
cases.action: Insert normal and recovery control rows for all mode/target combinations.
cases.oracle: Only exact normal or complete recovery tuples accepted; partial/mixed/zero/duplicate nonce combinations reject.

cases.initial_state: One valid handoff/lifecycle per allowed lifecycle state.
cases.action: Exhaustively attempt every documented lifecycle edge and every omitted/backward edge.
cases.oracle: Exactly documented edges CAS; invalid edge/mismatched generation/evidence rejects with byte-stable rows.

cases.initial_state: Prepared, claimed, completed and abandoned operation fixtures, one per operation kind.
cases.action: Exhaustively test operation CAS transition matrix and owner-generation rules including zero only for prepared/unclaimed and prepared-cancel abandoned.
cases.oracle: Legal state edges and exact owner predicates pass; terminal mutation, stale owner, zero claimed owner and unlisted edge reject.

cases.initial_state: Prepared, completed, abandoned, indeterminate, active, and terminal allocations.
cases.action: Test allocation_state and run_terminal_state matrices including active->abandoned/indeterminate exact CAS.
cases.oracle: Terminal allocation states and abandoned/indeterminate run states are immutable; active only takes enumerated exact terminal CAS; all other edges reject.

cases.initial_state: Created-root row plus EEXIST and no-root branches without root rows.
cases.action: Exercise containment and cleanup state edges for created root and forbidden mutations for no-root/EEXIST.
cases.oracle: Monotonic documented transitions pass only with exact receipt/evidence; EEXIST/no-root never acquires root-state row; invalid changes leave rows unchanged.

cases.initial_state: Lease singleton empty and occupied fixtures.
cases.action: Race two distinct exact owners; then attempt wrong-owner release, owner substitution, delete, and release before containment evidence.
cases.oracle: Exactly one acquire; wrong release/transfer/delete and premature release reject; owner retained until exact terminal predicate.

cases.initial_state: Intent/finish outbox fixtures in ready, send_authorized, acknowledged, suppressed states.
cases.action: Exercise delivery, ACK, cancellation race and all illegal state/correlation/digest transitions.
cases.oracle: Only ready->send_authorized->acknowledged and eligible intent ready->suppressed with exact receipt; ACK identity immutable; race has one linearized winner.

cases.initial_state: Valid normal lifecycle with exact created receipt and ACK.
cases.action: Run Prepare, Claim, verified root create, Finish, ACK, active, close, containment evidence, cleanup and finalization.
cases.oracle: All branch invariants pass in transaction order; lease releases only after exact empty containment and final CAS.

cases.initial_state: Valid root-create returns exact EEXIST collision proof.
cases.action: Run receipt/ACK and collision reconciliation paths.
cases.oracle: No root-state row or readiness; allocation/result indeterminate and lease held; no terminal success or release.

cases.initial_state: Prepared root operation, owner_generation=0, no Claim/dispatch, exact pinned absence.
cases.action: Race CancelPreparedRunRoot against AuthorizeOutboxSend for ready intent (never-authorized cancellation), then separately cancel with an already-acknowledged intent; unregister and finalize each valid branch.
cases.oracle: Ready intent suppresses only with exact no-send receipt; acknowledged intent remains acknowledged. Validator joins the cancellation receipt to the unique outbox row and checks ACK digest/correlation there; correlation is not encoded in canonical receipt CBOR. Both branches create no root row and retain lease until containment/finalize; send_authorized without ACK blocks cancellation.

cases.initial_state: Registered lifecycle with no root operation/allocation/lease and exact close binding.
cases.action: Finalize no-root abort and attempt forged allocation/lease/finish event.
cases.oracle: No-root finalizer succeeds only with exact contract; fabricated root-side rows/events reject; no lease ever acquired.

cases.initial_state: For each mutating method, snapshot exact schema+rows before call.
cases.action: Inject failures before commit, during rollback, and after successful commit before caller receives result; reopen independently.
cases.oracle: Pre-commit leaves exact before image; post-commit is discoverable as exact durable replay; no ambiguous second operation or lease owner.

cases.initial_state: Two SQLite handles/processes, same business key and controlled distinct keys.
cases.action: Race same-key prepare, stale auth fence vs prepare, close vs dispatch authorization, and independent opener initialization.
cases.oracle: Single linearization winner per contract; no duplicate operation/epoch/side effect; losers receive deterministic conflict/deny; exact row digests recorded.

cases.initial_state: Fresh isolated DB with immutable test quota parameters global=7, tenant=5, principal=3; test boundaries independently while other scopes remain below quota.
cases.action: From zero, insert valid allocations one at a time through ceil(limit*80/100) and ceil(limit*90/100), asserting one durable event for each scope/threshold, then replay an existing key and attempt a new key at N+1.
cases.oracle: Threshold event is inserted exactly at first count >= ceil(limit*percent/100), once per scope/threshold; limits 3 yields both 80/90 events at count 3, 5 yields 80 at 4 and 90 at 5, 7 yields 80 at 6 and 90 at 7. Replay/close/cleanup remain available at N; N+1 rejects unchanged.

cases.initial_state: Fresh test DB with global=7, tenant=5, principal=3; constrained principal is at 2/3, tenant at 4/5, global at 6/7; no lease is held.
cases.action: Part A: use the exact shared production helper called after current authorization fence and business-key replay lookup: counter read -> quota decision -> allocation INSERT. Run with 32 independent connections and test harness skips only lease acquire; do not use raw INSERT-only test. Part B: with no lease held, admit one full-path run at N-1, close/release lease, then submit 31 distinct new business keys.
cases.oracle: Part A: one transaction at N-1 inserts; others reject specifically at quota decision; trigger increments counters/events once and no lease-busy can satisfy result. Part B: first full-path run closes/releases; all 31 reject at pre-lease quota check without writes/side effects. Exact replay still bypasses quota but never bypasses current authorization fence.

cases.initial_state: Fresh isolated DB with immutable test quota parameters global=7, tenant=5, principal=3; test boundaries independently while other scopes remain below quota.
cases.action: Attempt new key, replay, and close for scopes at different quota edges; compare counters with an exact count of permanent allocation tombstones.
cases.oracle: Nested independent limits apply: principal usage contributes to tenant and global; unrelated scopes do not. Replay and close remain available. Counter values equal exact allocation tombstone counts.

cases.initial_state: Linux x86-64 reference host, 4 dedicated vCPU, 16 GiB RAM, local NVMe, Ubuntu 24.04 LTS, SQLite 3.45.x pinned image; Go release; WAL/synchronous FULL; 1,000,000 allocation/business rows, 100,000 principals, 10 tenants; 64 KiB payload+receipt+event bytes per 100 rows. Benchmark-only immutable caps global=1,500,000, tenant=250,000, principal=10,000. Run warm-cache and cold-cache datasets separately.
cases.action: Run 5 warm-up rounds and 30 measured rounds. Before each mutating batch, restore read-only 1,000,000-row baseline; restore excluded from timing. New-admission batch: 10,000 distinct admissions, each completed and closed. Prepare separate exact-at-capacity datasets for global, one tenant, and one principal rejection (10,000 attempts each per round); other scopes remain below cap. Prepare separate active-run dataset for 10,000 legal closes per round. Exact replay uses baseline. Capture raw samples and environment.
cases.oracle: Pass only if capacity lookup reads exactly three counter rows by PK (<=3 rows); allocation INSERT trigger updates those three; replay p95<=10ms; new admission and capacity rejection p95<=50ms; writer-lock p99<=100ms; no hot-path scans; quota race zero overshoot. Each workload uses prepared independent datasets and samples only the named operation; publish raw samples, p50/p95/p99, lock hold, scans, WAL peak, DB size and cache prep.

cases.initial_state: Persisted v3 database has exact counters; a copied fixture has one counter incremented or decremented.
cases.action: Open healthy and drifted copies separately. Drift fixtures: increment/decrement each scope, remove each scope row, add a schema-valid zero-count scope row with no allocation, and add an invalid-sentinel row by enabling ignore_check_constraints only during fixture corruption. Reconcile each copy before admission.
cases.oracle: Healthy counters and alert events reconcile exactly. Every drifted/missing/orphan/invalid-sentinel case fences admission, emits safe diagnostic, does no auto-repair/reseed/delete, and preserves byte-stable rows after rejected admission.

cases.initial_state: v3 DB initialized with immutable global/tenant/principal caps, then closed cleanly.
cases.action: Reopen with exact matching policy, then try one changed quota value and one missing/extra policy row.
cases.oracle: Exact config reopens; any mismatch, missing or extra row rejects without schema, user_version, policy, counter, or data mutation; no silent quota increase/decrease.

cases.initial_state: The protected v3 ledger has a seeded sequence-zero journal anchor. A durable journal contains a valid prefix and may have a torn or one-record-ahead tail.
cases.action: Exercise initial journal creation with parent-directory fsync fault; normal append; crash after frame fdatasync but before anchor CAS; crash after anchor commit; restore an older complete journal prefix; present a journal more than one record ahead; and change journal ID, sequence, or hash directly.
cases.oracle: Initial creation remains offline until both file and parent directory sync succeed. Normal and exactly-one-record-ahead recovery converge to one matching sequence/hash before ACK or side effect. Older prefix, impossible lead, journal-ID mismatch, nonconsecutive CAS, and hash mutation fence admission without reseeding or row mutation.

cases.initial_state: A valid ledger and launcher journal share an old restore generation. A trusted deployment-control marker is bound to a fresh boot challenge and reports a higher restore generation after a simulated platform snapshot restore.
cases.action: Present the old paired DB+journal with a valid current marker, a replayed/stale marker, an invalid signature, a wrong host/challenge, an unavailable marker service, and then the approved offline recovery marker for a new empty ledger.
cases.oracle: The old pair is rejected before journal lookup or admission when its restore generation mismatches or the marker cannot be verified. The approved recovery path keeps the old ledger read-only, requires old process retirement/root quarantine evidence, initializes a new empty ledger and journal under the new marker, and rejects old namespace keys. No old business rows or leases are imported.

cases.initial_state: The pinned production SQLite driver is registered with a deterministic test-only ConnectHook fault switch. No ledger pool or service is published; the hook can fail for a selected physical connection before authorizer installation.
cases.action: Open the protected ledger with the hook failing on the first and then a later physical connection while forcing pool expansion. Attempt readiness publication and an RPC; afterward disable the fault and open a fresh pool.
cases.oracle: Every hook failure closes the physical connection and causes initialization/readiness to fail before any RPC or mutation. No unprotected connection is returned or reused; the fresh healthy pool is usable and all its connections enforce policy. Error logs identify stage/connection class without SQL payload, key, or identity.

cases.initial_state: A healthy protected v3 store uses the exact pinned production database/sql driver; MaxOpenConns is at least 8 and each test connection is explicitly pinned and held concurrently to force eight distinct physical connections.
cases.action: On every pinned connection, independently attempt unauthorized INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE, CREATE/DROP including TEMP objects, ATTACH/DETACH, and mutating PRAGMA; then execute permitted reads. Include trigger-originated counter/alert writes and direct SQL that mimics trigger statements.
cases.oracle: All eight connections reject every unauthorized operation and allow reads. Only writes originating from the exact approved trigger succeed; equivalent direct SQL is denied. The test proves distinct physical handles were concurrently live and records the driver version and connection count.

cases.initial_state: The protected pool has at least two physical connections and only typed store methods can request an unexported per-connection capability; a test seam can inject an error and panic after capability grant but before transaction completion.
cases.action: Run one authorized typed mutation through success, returned-error, and panic paths; recover the panic at the test boundary. Reacquire the same physical connection and another pooled connection, attempt the same SQL raw and through an unrelated typed method, and verify trigger-only capabilities separately.
cases.oracle: The scoped operation succeeds only for its exact fixed statement/transaction. Capability is cleared before the connection is returned on all exits, including panic; rollback leaves no partial state. Raw replay and unrelated methods are denied on reused and other connections, and an approved trigger remains the only trigger-source exception.

artifacts.purpose: Deterministic signed and malformed authorization-envelope conformance vectors; public key only.
